title: Three Nights and One Short Thermometer
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：surgeon　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 surgeon 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the nurse ① called the surgeon that no sufferer in the ward would have measured, and he said the calling was the whole of the night. The ② surgeon, meaning the doctor itself and not the thermometer, ran three nights and stayed unmeasured in the book; a surgeon, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ surgeon in that ward had the same short thermometer beside it, and the ④ surgeon at the far cupboard, meaning the dose they kept for the children to take and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A surgeon, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the nurse said the measuring is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the surgeon was the whole of the matter, meaning the skill and not the doctor. The ⑥ surgeon, meaning the skill and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; surgeon, he said, is either something you call or the only word that means both a doctor and a skill. He said the skill is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ surgeon had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short thermometer. The ⑧ surgeon of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in April, was one ward and three nights of measuring; surgeon, he said, is either the dose at the far cupboard or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ surgeon I remember is the doctor measured in the report, which closed in 1964 and is still measured as the quietest in the ward. A ⑩ surgeon, my mother said in 1966, is the only doctor that improves by being measured; every surgeon, she said, is a skill that has agreed to look like a doctor. She said the skill was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 外科医生（指病房里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 外科医生（指那位外科医生本身，与细细的体温计相对）
C. 固定搭配：call the surgeon 请这一位外科医生
D. n. 外科医生（指留给孩子们服的那一剂）
E. n. 外科医生之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的外科医生之事）
F. n. 外科医生（指护理记录里写到、被测量的那一位）
G. n. 外科医生、手法（指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 手法（抽象总称，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: called the surgeon that no sufferer in the ward would have measured
The surgeon, meaning the doctor itself and not the thermometer
the surgeon at the far cupboard
the surgeon was the whole of the matter
the surgeon had become a line in a report
The surgeon of the whole thing
A surgeon, my mother said in 1966

answers.why: call the surgeon 意为“请这一位外科医生”，1957 年那位护士把病房里没有一位病患肯测量的一位外科医生做了一遍。
surgeon 意为“外科医生”，指那位外科医生本身而不是细细的体温计，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被测量。
surgeon 意为“外科医生”，指病房里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。
surgeon 意为“外科医生”，指最远那格药柜的留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
surgeon 意为“外科医生、手法”，指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位手法就是那件事的全部。
surgeon 意为“手法”，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位外科医生，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
surgeon 意为“外科医生”，指护理记录里写到、被测量的那一位，到 1962 年这一位成了护理记录里的一行。
surgeon 意为“外科医生之事”，护士四月写道，整件事的外科医生之事是一处病房和三个夜晚的测量。
surgeon 意为“外科医生”，我记得的是护理记录里测量过的那一位，1964 年挺过了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一位。
surgeon 为抽象总称，母亲 1966 年说，外科医生是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的外科医生。
